description: Change of use from Class C3 (Dwellinghouse) to Class C4 (HMO) for up to 3 Occupants. (Retrospective Planning Application)

phasing_details.phase_detail: There is no building taking place. The property has been used for 21 years to rent to university students and planning permission is now required to change use from C3 to C4 to continue doing this.

decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans, numbers 6051-1 and 75 Brambles Drive UB10 0DY, and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
To ensure the development complies with the provisions Hillingdon Local Plan Parts 1 (November 2012) and 2 (January 2020) and the London Plan (2021).
The hereby approved development shall be used as a house in multiple occupation for no more than 3 persons (individuals) at any one time.

To ensure that the amenity of the occupiers of adjacent properties is not adversely affected, and to ensure that the unit provides a satisfactory internal living environment for the occupiers, in accordance with Policies DMH 5, DMHB 11, DMHB 16 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 (2020), and Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021).
The proposed secure cycle storage for 3 cycle parking spaces as shown on submitted plan reference 75 Brambles Drive UB10 0DY shall be retained at the property in perpetuity.
To ensure the provision of accessible and policy-compliant cycle parking in accordance with Policy T5 of the London Plan (2021).

Within 3 months of the date of this permission, the electric vehicle charging point shown on the approved plans shall be installed and made available for use. The charging points shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.

To encourage the use of sustainable modes of transport and reduce emissions in accordance with Policies DMT 1 and DMT 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020) and Policies T6 and SI 2 of the London Plan (2021).
